nodes.description: Administrator address of the delegator, set to msg.sender during construction and to admin_ afterwards; guards _setImplementation.
Pending administrator slot declared in storage but never written in this contract.
Address of the active implementation contract used by the fallback delegatecall and updated by _setImplementation.
Constructor: sets admin to msg.sender, delegatecalls initialize(address) on implementation_ and calls _setImplementation, then hands admin over to admin_.
Public admin-only function that validates and stores a new implementation address and emits NewImplementation.
Internal helper performing an unchecked low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary callee with arbitrary calldata.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls msg.data to the stored implementation and forwards the returned data or revert.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for the initial admin assignment and the admin-only authorization check.
Low-level callee.delegatecall(data) executed inside delegateTo during construction with attacker-independent but arbitrary calldata.
Low-level implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in the fallback, giving the implementation full control over the delegator storage context.
Constructor parameter admin_ that becomes the final administrator address.
Constructor parameter rewardToken_ encoded into the initialize(address) delegatecall.
Constructor parameter implementation_ used as the delegatecall target and the initially stored implementation.
Parameter implementation_ of _setImplementation, validated as non-zero and written to storage.
Parameter callee of delegateTo, the arbitrary address receiving the delegatecall.
Parameter data of delegateTo, the raw calldata passed to the delegatecall.
Local copy of the previous implementation address, only used for the NewImplementation event.
Boolean success flag returned by the low-level delegatecall.
Bytes returned by the low-level delegatecall, used in the assembly revert path.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the admin state variable during construction.
msg.sender must equal admin to pass the require gate in _setImplementation.
_setImplementation reads the admin state variable for its authorization check.
Constructor parameter implementation_ flows into _setImplementation and is stored as the active implementation.
_setImplementation parameter implementation_ is written directly to the implementation state variable.
The constructor invokes delegateTo to run initialize(address) on the implementation.
The constructor calls _setImplementation to persist the initial implementation.
delegateTo performs an unrestricted delegatecall to the caller-supplied callee address.
The fallback executes implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) for every unmatched call.
The fallback reads the implementation state variable and uses it as the delegatecall target.
The callee parameter is the target of the low-level delegatecall, letting the caller choose the code executed.
The data parameter is supplied as calldata to the low-level delegatecall.
The current implementation state variable is copied into the oldImplementation local before being overwritten.
The delegatecall returns the success boolean into the success local variable.
The delegatecall returns raw bytes into returnData, later used by the assembly revert.

normalization_plan.reason: admin_ is only consumed by the constructor assignment admin = admin_, so it is normalized into the constructor node.
rewardToken_ exists only to build the initialize(address) calldata inside the constructor.
implementation_ is the delegatecall target passed from the constructor into delegateTo.
implementation_ is the sole input of _setImplementation and directly determines the stored implementation.
callee is the direct target of callee.delegatecall(data) and has no other use.
data is the direct calldata argument of callee.delegatecall(data).
oldImplementation is a transient copy used only for the NewImplementation event inside _setImplementation.
success is the boolean result of the delegatecall and is only inspected by the assembly revert branch.
returnData holds the delegatecall return bytes and is only consumed by the assembly revert.
